title: Cybercriminals used WebRTC to steal credit card data from several large online retailers
content_md:
Cybercriminals used Web Real Time Communication (WebRTC) as an attack vector to steal credit card data from several large online retailers.

via Mastodon https://www.heise.de/news/Zum-Black-Friday-Kreditkarten-Skimming-via-WebRTC-entdeckt-11541584.html
